lat: shbe3t b l-khobz w t-tajin
en: I was full from the bread and tajine.

lat: ma shbe3tsh mn l-makla dyal l-bare7
ar: ما شبعتش من الماكلة ديال البارح
en: I didn't get full from yesterday's food.

lat: wash shbe3ti mn l-ghda a khay?
ar: واش شبعتي من الغدا ا خاي؟
en: Did you get full from lunch, brother?

lat: ma shbe3tish b had s-sandwish s-sghir
en: You didn't get full from this small sandwich.

lat: shbe3ti b seksu dyal l-bare7?
en: Did you (f.) get full from yesterday's couscous?

lat: ma shbe3tish 7it kliti ghir shwiya
ar: ما شبعتيش حيت كليتي غير شوية
en: You (f.) didn't get full because you only ate a little.

lat: huwa shbe3 dghya f l-3sha
en: He got full quickly at dinner.

lat: ma shbe3sh w bgha yzid l-makla
ar: ما شبعش و بغا يزيد الماكلة
en: He didn't get full and wanted more food.

lat: sheb3at b z-zitun w l-khobz
en: She was full from the olives and bread.

lat: ma sheb3atsh mn had sh-shorba
en: She didn't get full from this soup.

lat: shbe3na b l-ftur dyal l-yum
en: We were full from today's breakfast.

lat: ma shbe3nash 7it t-tebsil kan sghir
ar: ما شبعناش حيت التبصيل كان صغير
en: We didn't get full because the plate was small.

lat: wash ntuma shbe3tu b l-l7em?
en: Did you (pl.) get full from the meat?

lat: ma shbe3tush mn l-ghda f d-dar?
en: Didn't you (pl.) get full from lunch at home?

lat: huma sheb3u b l-7elwa w atay
en: They were full from the pastry and tea.

lat: d-drari ma sheb3ush mn l-3des
en: The boys didn't get full from the lentils.

lat: dima kanshbe3 dghya b l-khobz
en: I always get full quickly with bread.

lat: ana ma kanshbe3sh b sh-shlada bu7dha
en: I don't get full from salad alone.

lat: dima katshbe3 deghya f l-3sha
en: You always get full quickly at dinner.

lat: nta ma katshbe3sh b l-fakya bu7dha
en: You (m.) don't get full from fruit alone.

lat: wash katsheb3i b s-sandwish f l-khedma?
en: Do you (f.) get full with a sandwich at work?

lat: nti ma katsheb3ish b l-bayd l-mesluq
en: You (f.) don't get full from the boiled eggs.

lat: huwa kayshbe3 b z-zlafa dyal l-7rira
en: He gets full with a bowl of harira.

lat: khuya ma kayshbe3sh b l-makla l-khafifa
en: My brother does not get full with light food.

lat: khti katshbe3 dghya b shwiya dyal l-makla
ar: ختي كتشبع دغيا بشوية ديال الماكلة
en: My sister gets full quickly with a little food.

lat: l-bent ma katshbe3sh mn had l-wejba
ar: البنت ما كتشبعش من هاد الوجبة
en: The girl does not get full from this meal.

lat: 7na kansheb3u dima f d-dar dyalna
en: We always get full at our house.

lat: 7na ma kansheb3ush b had sh-shi
en: We don't get full with this stuff.

lat: wash katsheb3u b l-makla dyal r-restu?
en: Do you (pl.) get full with restaurant food?

lat: ntuma ma katsheb3ush bla khobz f l-makla
ar: نتوما ما كتشبعوش بلا خبز فالماكلة
en: You (pl.) don't get full without bread in meals.

lat: huma kaysheb3u b seksu kul jem3a
en: They get full from couscous every Friday.

lat: huma ma kaysheb3ush dghya f l-3rasat
en: They don't get full quickly at weddings.

lat: ghadi nshbe3 b had t-tajin l-kbir
en: I will get full from this big tajine.

lat: ma ghadish nshbe3 b had l-morsu s-sghir
ar: ما غاديش نشبع بهاد المورصو الصغير
en: I will not get full from this small piece.

lat: nta ghadi tshbe3 b had l-pitsa
en: You (m.) will get full from this pizza.

lat: ma ghadish tshbe3 ila kliti ghir teffa7a
ar: ما غاديش تشبع ايلا كليتي غير تفاحة
en: You (m.) will not get full if you only eat an apple.

lat: nti ghadi tsheb3i b had l-wejba
en: You (f.) will get full from this meal.

lat: ma ghadish tsheb3i b sh-shlada s-sghira
en: You (f.) will not get full with the small salad.

lat: huwa ghadi yshbe3 b had s-seffa
en: He will get full from this seffa.

lat: huwa ma ghadish yshbe3 b had l-khobza
ar: هو ما غاديش يشبع بهاد الخبزة
en: He will not get full with this bread.

lat: hiya ghadi tshbe3 b had z-zlafa
en: She will get full with this bowl.

lat: l-bent ma ghadish tshbe3 b had l-7rira
ar: البنت ما غاديش تشبع بهاد الحريرة
en: The girl will not get full with this harira.

lat: 7na ghadi nsheb3u f had l-3sha
en: We will get full at this dinner.

lat: 7na ma ghadish nsheb3u bla l-l7em
ar: حنا ما غاديش نشبعو بلا اللحم
en: We will not get full without the meat.

lat: ntuma ghadi tsheb3u b had d-djaj
en: You (pl.) will get full with this chicken.

lat: ma ghadish tsheb3u b kas d atay
ar: ما غاديش تشبعو بكاس د اتاي
en: You (pl.) will not get full with a glass of tea.

lat: d-dyaf ghadi ysheb3u b l-makla l-mezyana
en: The guests will get full from the good food.

lat: huma ma ghadish ysheb3u b sh-shorba
en: They will not get full with the soup.
